title: Classic Tiramisu
method: Whip the double cream and sugar together until soft peaks form.
Gently fold the mascarpone and vanilla into the whipped cream until smooth and combined.
Combine the cooled brewed coffee and optional coffee liqueur in a shallow dish.
Briefly dip ladyfingers into the coffee liquid and arrange a single layer across the base of your serving dish.
Spread half of the mascarpone cream over the biscuits, then repeat with a second dipped biscuit layer and the remaining cream.
Dust cocoa powder evenly over the top layer and chill for at least 4 hours (ideally overnight) before serving.
